name: KXHIGH cheap-bracket offers (maker)
description: wx-maker's code with offers only on cheap KXHIGH brackets (mid 2-10c), quoted from listing until 13:00 local on the market day: sell YES lottery tickets to retail YES buyers (who lose 1-2c per contract at every low band, both halves, all cities in the trade-print grid) with no maker fee.
hypothesis: Taker YES buyers of <10c brackets lose 1-2c/ct net of fee consistently (grid, 10 cities, both halves); a resting offer collects that without fees, if adverse selection (brackets that become live) stays below it. wx-maker's wide mid band (5-50c) averaged -0.3..+0.9c; the cheap band is where takers lose most. Wrong if CI <= 0.
next: Lockbox weak pass (Sep 1-Oct 22): +0.64c/ct, CI -1.84..+2.84, 389 mkts, 28/40 days; Sep -0.04c (298 mkts), Oct +2.8c, recorded real books Oct 13-22 +2.8c (58 mkts, CI -0.8..+6.0). Same code as wx-maker with a cheap-band param set: needs paper on recorded KXHIGH books to check real queue fills and adverse selection; extend to the other 7 cities (memory-limited here). User decides paper.
